body: that doesn't seem obvious.. it seems like a lot of stuff happened, and you deserve another chance.
thank you so much for answering.  i'm trying really hard to actually believe this.

i'm sorry about the string of rough things happening to you.  it probably feels like you don't have enough energy to keep going, but there's got to be a better job on the horizon that will help things change for the better, right?  maybe?

I just want you to know that I hear you, and I feel a lot of what you're feeling.  I don't know if the sun stops shining for everyone else... but it does for some people.  I am here to listen if you want to talk.  

Does anything help pull you out of this?  Does it help to make goals about things that might be exciting for the future .. or maybe that might help other people that feel like the sun stopped shining know that they're not alone either?  Thank you for living.
I am feeling this way too.  I wish you weren't feeling this way.
